[[File:ThermalShields-CaM.png|thumb|right|250px|Thermal shields protect ''Invincible''{{'s}} bridge from proton torpedos]]
A '''thermal shield''' was a more powerful version of the more common [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]. Like the deflector shield, Thermal shields could deflect laser and projectile fire and could withstand a direct hit from a volley of [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]]. However, this absorbed at least half of the shield's power. Torpedoes could not be fired while thermal shields were up, as they would not be able to pass through the shield barrier. Once down, the shields could not be raised again until fully recharged.<ref name="CAM">{{TCW|Cat and Mouse}}</ref> The shielding could also be used as protective cover for [[ionization reactor]]s aboard [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]].<ref name="Jedi's Honor">''[[Jedi's Honor]]''</ref>

The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] was known to have thermal shields installed on a number of his warships, including his [[Invincible/Legends|flagship]]. The shields were used to great effect during the [[Christophsis blockade/Legends|blockade]] of [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]. However, the recharge time of the shield resulted in the apparent [[Death/Legends|death]] of Trench, after he lowered his shields to fire upon [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] prototype [[Stealth ship/Legends|Stealth ship]].<ref name="CAM" />
